scope: Existing interactive native AgentHub task startup prerequisite and finite CLI ownership; no logon/reboot, host deployment or full repository-suite acceptance
selectors: refuses another account before issuing any Docker or runner command
preserves an existing listener instead of creating a duplicate
does not start or switch Docker when a different engine is healthy
starts only the listener when Linux Docker is already ready
fails closed when the supported Desktop startup fails
requires a fresh Linux API response after successful Desktop startup
settles a bounded real CLI probe without leaking output into its result
removes ambient Docker connection overrides only from its child
terminates only its owned finite CLI client on timeout
does not issue lifecycle commands during WhatIf
refuses a listener that appears after Docker readiness
preserves Desktop appearing during the local API probe
launches only the qualified application through a bounded hidden native helper
rejects a timed-out application launch helper
rejects a launch result whose captured error pipe did not settle
settles captured helper pipes while a real noisy application survives
qualifies an unreadable foreign listener by its registered service parent
refuses an unreadable listener without registered service parent proof
rationale: Each selector has inline Protects/Detects/Needs and implementation/review breadcrumbs. Failure controls exercise identity, duplicate/late listener ownership, wrong engine, startup failure, actual local daemon selection and child environment isolation. Positive and real finite-process controls prevent blanket refusal or fake mocked process acceptance. The surviving child writes 1MiB on each stream before readiness; the published implementation fails that exact real control. Native startup receives only an allowlisted inheritable NUL handle while finite helper diagnostics remain captured.
needs: Windows, PowerShell7, Pester5; mocks for Docker/runner decisions and real finite PowerShell CLI child controls; installed Windows Framework64 v4.0.30319/csc.exe for the surviving console-child fixture
